data.title: 风见一姬 · 避难木屋的炉火温存
data.description: 【风见一姬 · 避难木屋的炉火温存】风雨交加的夜晚，深山简陋原木避难小屋内，壁炉中燃烧着劈啪作响的橘红柴火。一姬抱膝蜷坐在厚厚的毛毯堆上，火光将她雪白的肌肤与连身裙镀上一层暖金色的光晕。她静静凝视着跳动的炭火，单手轻拨着发梢，在狂风呼啸的孤岛中，展现出能融化一切严寒的心灵坚韧。
data.location: 深山避难原木小屋柴火壁炉前
data.action: 抱膝蜷坐在火炉旁毛毯上，火光映照侧脸，眼神温柔而坚定
data.lighting: 壁炉木柴燃烧的炽热橙红暖光与小屋外漆黑风雨的强烈冷暖反差
data.camera: medium close-up, eye-level warmth, intimate cozy contrast
data.promptProse: Kazuki curls on a pile of thick blankets inside the rough log shelter, wearing her white sundress and hugging her knees as she watches the fireplace and lightly touches her hair tips. The eye-level medium close-up includes rough timber and the dark rain-marked opening behind. Orange-red firelight warms her pale dress and silver hair, with deep outside storm darkness contrasting against layered blanket shadows beneath her hands.
